paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training loss of SepLLM models with varying configurations over the course of training iterations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", represents a linear scale ranging from approximately 95000 to 125000, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2500. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," displays values ranging from approximately 1.95 to 2.85, utilizing a linear scale. A magenta line, representing SepLLM (n=64, larger lr), shows an initial loss value of approximately 2.75 at iteration 95000 and gradually decreases to approximately 2.15 at iteration 125000. A blue line depicts SepLLM (n=128), beginning with a loss of approximately 2.78 at iteration 95000 and decreasing to approximately 2.10 at iteration 125000. An orange line represents SepLLM (n=64), demonstrating a loss starting at approximately 2.75 at iteration 95000 and reaching a value of approximately 2.12 at iteration 125000. Finally, a red, dashed line, representing Vanilla before post-training, shows a constant loss value of approximately 2.20 across the entire range of iterations.
